market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are the most recent IPL champions (2024) and historically have a win rate around 17% over 17 seasons. Even with roster churn and the two-year horizon, a baseline probability for any major franchise is about 10% (1 in 10 teams). The market-implied 2% appears too pessimistic for a competitive franchise without specific negative news. A 7% estimate is conservative and still leaves significant edge.
evidence_points: KKR won IPL 2024, demonstrating current organizational strength.
IPL has 10 teams; a naive equal-chance prior is 10%.
Long-term historical win rate for KKR is ~3 titles in 17 seasons (17.6%).
No indication of the team being disbanded or severely weakened for 2026.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL team parity and auction dynamics
